exclusive_cumprod: compute an exclusive cumulative product of a PyTorch tensor along a specified dimension
safe_cumprod: compute a numerically stable cumulative product using log-exp to prevent precision issues
lengths_to_mask: convert a tensor of sequence lengths into a boolean attention mask for batching
moving_sum: compute a moving sum over a 2D tensor using configurable start and end window indices
review_functions_module: review the simultaneous translation utility functions for exclusive cumprod, safe cumprod, mask generation, and moving sum
